description: This file defines the main search page component for a GitHub repositories search application built with Next.js and React. It handles user inputs, manages state for search filters and pagination, performs API requests or generates fallback mock data, and renders various UI components including the search form, sort controls, filters, results table, and pagination.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, updating search parameters and resetting to page 1.

methods.name: handleSortChange
methods.description: Handles changes in sorting options, updating sort parameters and resetting to page 1.

methods.name: handlePageChange
methods.description: Handles pagination changes, updating current page and page size.

methods.name: fetchResults
methods.description: Performs the search request to the backend or generates mock data if backend is unavailable, then updates the results state.
